# Getting started

The package rebuilds the 43 tables and 19 figures in manuscript version 104. Open the [artifact index](08-artifact-index.qmd) to find an exhibit by its printed number or download its unrounded values. The build runs from synthetic simulation data, model summaries, and the recorded calibration policy.

## Install the rebuild tools

Use R 4.6.0 and a Python version from 3.9 through 3.13 with the pinned Pillow wheel. The following example uses Python 3.13. Install pdfLaTeX, Lato, Fontconfig and Poppler as described in the [runtime requirements](records/toolchain.md). Quarto is needed to render this guide.

~~~sh
python3.13 -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/python3 -m pip install -r common/figure-requirements.txt
Rscript common/install_dependencies.R --profile rebuild --execute
Rscript 00_setup.R --profile rebuild
~~~

Run these commands in the repository root. The R installer restores the recorded dependency closure under `.library/`. Setup checks DPprior 2.0.0 and its production function definitions. Figure 4 uses R, pdfLaTeX and Poppler. Figure 5 uses Python, ReportLab, the verified Lato font files and Poppler. A separately installed Python environment can be selected with `DPP_PYTHON`. [Software versions](records/software-lock.csv)

## Rebuild and verify

~~~sh
Rscript exhibits/00_build_all.R
Rscript verify_reproduction.R
~~~

The numerical frames and formatted displays appear in `outputs/v104/`. Tables have CSV, HTML and LaTeX versions. Figures have CSV, PNG and vector PDF versions. Additional numerical frames for multi-panel figures appear in `data-derived/v104/`. Each exhibit has a receipt linking the files used to generate it. The verification record is `outputs/verification/reproduction.json`. [Reproduction map](records/reproduction-map.csv)

## Read the guide offline

The distributed guide includes its figure, table and code snapshots. Render it directly from the checkout and open `docs/_book/index.html`.

~~~sh
quarto render docs
python3 verification/check_book.py
~~~

To update the snapshots from a newly verified build, run the following from the repository root. The final check compares the current output, the guide snapshot and the rendered copy byte for byte.

~~~sh
python3 docs/sync_assets.py --execute
quarto render docs
python3 verification/check_book.py --current
~~~

The `calibration`, `public-data`, `refit` and `book` setup profiles check the requirements for their respective tasks. The [refitting chapter](07-verification-refit.qmd) gives commands for running one model.
